request.prompt: Instrumental arctic synth-pop for an arcade kart race through a snowy penguin village at sunset. 112 BPM, B minor. Glassy bells and glockenspiel, crystalline plucks, airy pads, bouncy half-time drums with crisp hi-hats. Playful and cool, constant energy so it can loop under a race. No intro, no ending, no fade-out, no vocals.
